sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2012
ACT I OF 2012
PUNJAB BUS STANDS AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (GUJRANWALA) ORDINANCE, 1963 (XX OF 1963)
(REPEAL) ACT, 2011
An Act to repeal the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control
(Gujranwala)
Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary,
3rd January, 2012]
No.PAP-Legis-2(94)/2011/496,
dated 3-1-2012.---The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (Repeal) Bill 2011, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 21st December 2011, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st December 2011, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to repeal the Punjab Bus
Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (XX of
1963);
It is enacted as follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may
be called the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala)
Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963) (Repeal) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.
